dialogues.text: Hello, darkness, my old friend...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... It's a... child who talks like an adult? That's so weird!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, isn't this the magnificent Magnifico?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Mag... Magnifico, the magnificent Magnifico!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Uh... I know that if anything, I look a bit down-on-out right now, but please, give me some water... Help me out here...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Water... Please... Thank you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... He's looking half-dead again... Should we help him?

choices.text: Not sure where we're getting "magnificent" from...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you've kinda dried out like a fish... Poor thing...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Hey! Have some human empathy, will you?

choices.text: Hello, old friend. It's me, darkness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...What?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Haha! Yeah, that's the one! I love that song too!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Ah... Simeon and Carbuncle... I never get tired of their music... But speaking of which, I lost my last job on their account. That's why I ended up here, taking this blasted risk...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Uh... but that's a story for later, haha. Right now, what really matters is, can you get me some water, please?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: After all, well... Haha... It's just... sorry, but I'm dying of thirst here, hehe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is life or death we're talking about, and yours, too! What are you giggling about!?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: No idea. Might be terminal lucidity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... huh!?

dialogues.text: Hello, darkness, my old friend...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... It's a... child who talks like an adult? That's so weird!
Hey, didn't your parents teach you any respect for people like me? We little folk can do great things too, you know!
In truth, many great things are accomplished by tiny people like me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, he's even got a beard! That's... kinda... Urgh...
Don't you use my beard to shame me!

choices.text: Hello, old friend. It's me, darkness.

response.text: Uh... No. No need to play along with me like that. What I mean to say is that I... haven't much time left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you're all dried up like a fish out of water... Poor you.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrrooo...
What? Hey! Where's your human empathy gone?
Give me water, would you? I'm dying of thirst over here, can't you see?
Ah, that's the stuff! This is the first time in the three days I've been stuck here that I've heard a human speak...!

I'll take 2 servings of Meal No. 9, one Big No. 9, one Meal No. 6 with extra sauce, one Meal No. 7, two servings of the No. 45, one with which I'll take some cheese, and a large glass of Fonta to top it all off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, and what else would you like?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrooo, Awrr?
What else do I need? What do you think? Water, you...! Can't you tell I'm parched?

choices.text: Calm down. How should we help you?

response.text: Water... Please... Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You figure out a way to help the thirsty person, and you notice that his body seems to have grown a size bigger after getting some water in his system.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Phew... *cough* *cough* Thank you... But... *cough* You could have saved me a bit less... aggressively... I can't swim, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we'd have figured out a way to reel you back in in time!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: I'd rather you not do any such thing on the fly, but regardless... thank you for saving me!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Magnifico de la Magnificans. Just "Magnifico" will do. As you can see, I am of noble Fontainian stock.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: My old friends sometimes call me "The Detective," at times "Brutus," and sometimes "Mr. Mag"... But you two may call me whatever you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This guy's kinda strange, don'cha think?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Hroor...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: I once worked at the Marechaussee Phantom as a detective for a few years, working on several major cases with Inspector Frank Drebin. He eventually made Superintendent, while I retired.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Ah, those were unforgettable days...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: A boy met a girl, the boy lost the girl, the girl searched for the boy, the boy forgot the girl, the boy remembered the girl, and the girl was crushed under one of the pretty Fontinalia Festival floats three times...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, you can stop with your weird flashbacks now...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: *cough* Anyway, after retiring from the Marechaussee Phantom, I was idle for a time, before deciding to become a photographer, capturing the vitality within people and objects...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: That is why I am here in Natlan — home to the most shockingly dazzling elemental life forms!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perhaps the most "shocking" thing of all is the way you almost bit it, right here...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Hehe, and you have my apologies for that. I will not forget that you saved my life.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: How about this... Let me mark the spot I'm going to next on your map... Yes, right here.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Ah, wait... Where have my manners gone? I haven't even asked for your names yet!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Call me Paimon! And this here is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrroo!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: #Wonderful, wonderful! {NICKNAME}... and Paimon. Names to remember, to be sure!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr? Roo? Raar—!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: #Haha, relax, relax! I'll remember you too, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: May we meet again soon in our respective journeys. Perhaps I might even need your help again... or perhaps you might need mine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're going that far out... Well, mind you don't get too thirsty, alright?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Haha, there's no way I'd do that! Let's meet again, shall we?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Magnifico quickly packs his bags and water supplies, then waves you goodbye.\nNot long after, his short silhouette disappears from sight.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Ah, you might not know this, but I used to be a detective with the Marechaussee Phantom for a few years, serving under Inspector Frank Drebin.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: There was once when we saw five people in robes attacking an old man with knives in the park, right in front of over a hundred people! And then, "bang, bang, bang, bang, bang!"

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Laid them all out, no exceptions. Hah! "Do you feel lucky, punk?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrraaa...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Later, the chief of police told me that they were Research Institute administrative staff rehearsing "Remuria."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Hence the name, "Brutus"!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wooraarr?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: It didn't matter, anyway. The Institute was cutting down on redundant staff at the time, so they'd have had to resign sooner or later.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Why, it's my extraordinary charm, of course. Such magnetism is mine that all who know me are inexorably drawn to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh...?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Also... all unassuming metal objects, scattered Mora, small jewelry, and so on, will be inexplicably attracted to my pockets!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aren't you more like "Mr. Klepto," then!?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Indeed, and that is one of my clan's great virtues!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Eee—！

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You figure out a way to help the thirsty person, and you notice that his body seems to have grown a size bigger after getting some water in his system.
*cough* *pant* Haha, I see, so that was an Iktomisaurus trick... Just one of the reasons I'm here, if you must know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, just take it easy and drink some water before we talk!
*cough* No, no, I'll be fine. Thank you for saving me!

dialogues.text: So... This guy almost died of thirst right by the water's edge?
Huh? So the water was this close by... Anyway, thank you for saving me!
